stores.producer: AssetCommands.CREATE and GUARDIAN_CREATE after Gateway authorization
stores.identity: profile UUID; ordinary assets have no app-scope column, so do not infer all assets belong to OT/TS
stores.writeFence: Reservation persisted before bytes; write lock and lease recheck before activation; compensation or retained cleanup row
stores.cancellation: Lease expiry/tombstone cleanup; does not implement D00 account-wide producer fencing
stores.restart: Pending row survives worker death; startup/poll reclaims expired work
stores.exportDisposition: Existing safe Assets capture; operational leases and storage paths excluded

stores.store: Process Map, active-write promises and transient recipient cancellation set; persisted Notification only after flush
stores.identity: recipient profile UUID; use only verified OT/TS profile context, no app partition is stored in Notification
stores.writeFence: Canonical typed pending payload; batch cancel clears timers and waits for started writes; shutdown drains started writes
stores.cancellation: Internal batch cancellation only; new work after acknowledgement is allowed; D00 owns permanent account fence
stores.restart: Pending debounce is intentionally lost on process death; no durable-delivery/replay promise
stores.exportDisposition: Pending operational payload excluded; durable notification uses J21 safe projection

stores.producer: Authenticated internal create/resume commands; frontend controls remain U01
stores.consumer: AccountExportJobService.run -> snapshot clients; explicit resume after interrupted lease
stores.store: account_export_jobs states, attempt, idempotency key, lease owner and expiry
stores.identity: account UUID AND appId; new cancel command restricted to client-interface/local-hub
stores.writeFence: Exact-scope locked cancellation clears lease; renewal and finish require current running attempt/nonce/unexpired lease
stores.cancellation: Current attempt cancelled as failed/EXPORT_JOB_CANCELLED; explicit resume may claim a new attempt
stores.restart: Cancelled state persists; stale finish cannot replace it; restart does not silently resume with stored credentials
stores.exportDisposition: Typed existing owner receipt; bearer credentials never persisted; artifact remains unavailable

stores.producer: Operator-approved policy notice scheduling for guardian relationships
stores.identity: guardian account UUID plus related GuardianPermission app anchors; mixed/unproven product scope refuses suppression
stores.writeFence: Delivery row lock held through provider result; suppression waits for active send and cannot overwrite accepted delivery
stores.cancellation: Internal pending/sending suppression for established OT/TS context; accepted provider message cannot be recalled
stores.restart: Suppressed/accepted rows not replayed; expired sending lease can be reclaimed; shutdown drains started delivery
stores.exportDisposition: Typed Authentication receipt; no email/DOB/token/provider payload in ordinary work inventory

stores.producer: OT/TS community invitation -> persisted invitation -> Gateway mailer
stores.store: community_invite is durable; email has no local outbox/retry record
stores.identity: inviter/invitee account or email domains plus community/app scope; secret token is not an ownership proof
stores.writeFence: Invitation status/token acceptance remains authoritative; network provider calls have transport deadlines
stores.cancellation: Existing invitation cancellation invalidates local acceptance; cannot retract already accepted external email
stores.restart: No durable email retry promise; in-app invitation remains discoverable when mail fails
stores.exportDisposition: Existing branch-safe Social invitation receipt; tokens and unmatched identities excluded; provider-held execution is X01

stores.producer: Guardian permission and guardian audit lifecycle timers
stores.consumer: Auth GuardianPermissionService, Social GuardianContentService, Assets audit cleanup
stores.store: Existing guardian_permission, guardian_content_audit and guardian_asset_activity rows; no separate queue payload
stores.identity: Existing account/profile/app attribution; no new cross-product selection
stores.writeFence: Conditional lifecycle updates/deletes; no delayed content producer or account re-creation
stores.cancellation: Not a notification delivery queue; account deletion coordination belongs D00 and sink retention to R2/N04
stores.restart: Startup and periodic passes operate on persisted predicates; no hidden retry payload
stores.exportDisposition: Existing owner dispositions; no additional export source invented

stores.producer: Authenticated export job -> Profile/owner snapshot handles
stores.consumer: Snapshot expiry timers, pull clients and owner spool cleanup
stores.store: Process handle maps, temporary identity tables, bounded NDJSON spools
stores.identity: Lease-bound account/app/job/attempt/nonce and captured Profile parent
stores.writeFence: Current lease validated for reads/commit; bounded capture abort/cleanup; no application-data writes
stores.cancellation: Cancellation invalidates lease and read handles; cleanup is bounded/finally/TTL, not an immediate global byte-deletion acknowledgement
stores.restart: Restart invalidates handles; callers recapture under a new lease, no stored bearer-token auto-resume
stores.exportDisposition: Operational state excluded; safe owner records already qualified at individual receipts

stores.store: Request bytes and bounded scanner socket/deadline state; no durable queue
stores.identity: Acting profile derived by Gateway; validation/scanner payload is not an owner selector
stores.writeFence: Validation and scanner failure happen before asset write; finite byte/response/deadline caps
stores.cancellation: Request abort/deadline; no durable scan replay job
stores.restart: No hidden scan retry store; a failed request must be retried explicitly
stores.exportDisposition: No scanner payload export; N01 lifecycle fixture controls clean scan result and does not qualify malware detection

stores.store: Durable auth_action_token credential metadata; no local email outbox or deferred payload
stores.identity: Account/email/action and application context; raw bearer token is not an ownership selector
stores.writeFence: Existing token expiry/single-use/state validation controls action acceptance; provider calls have transport timeouts
stores.cancellation: Local credential invalidation blocks later action use, not recall of accepted provider email; D00 supplies account operation fencing
stores.restart: No hidden local send replay; existing credential validation remains authoritative
stores.exportDisposition: Existing safe Authentication capture; token secrets/provider payload excluded; real external execution stays X01

explicitExclusions.reason: No create-video producer was demonstrated in the two primary clients; no new Videos/transcoder implementation or qualification in N01.
Cache state, log sinks, media bytes/versions, browser storage and external grants retain their existing boundaries; this inventory does not silently close them.

Conditional AI-recipient polling has no demonstrated AI-producing call in the scoped client Messages components/services; no AI orchestration/Telos qualification is introduced. Ordinary socket/session state stays N02.

acceptance: Complete producer/store/consumer dispositions plus write/cancel fencing and real restart/readback; source presence alone is insufficient.
acceptanceBoundary: Per-work-item fencing and cancellation only. Permanent account-wide producer fencing and deletion remain D00 and its adapters.
